data.name: Hetvika
data.gender_notes: Hetvika is used as a unisex name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Hetvika is derived from the Sanskrit word 'hetu', meaning 'cause' or 'reason'. The name implies a person who is wise and intellectually sharp. In Hindu mythology, Hetvika is a name of a river goddess, symbolizing the power of knowledge and wisdom. The name Hetvika carries the meaning “Wisdom and Intellect” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Hetvika usually hope their child will grow to embody wisdom and intellect and live with faith, good character and purpose.
